[🔁🚨PhD opening]

We have a new opening for a PhD student at our @FunAILab at the University of Technology Nuremberg on combining Vision-Language-Action Models with 3D Geometry.

This PhD position is in close collaboration with @HelsingAI with the amazing researcher @TomUnterthiner and will be a unique opportunity to conduct research and have impact.

Please see below for more information:
https://t.co/9FU8ryPTPN

We particularly encourage applications from people of diverse and underrepresented backgrounds. If you have any doubt if you should apply or not, send me a message.
chinese_translation:
【🔁🚨博士职位开放】

我们在纽伦堡工业大学 @FunAILab 有一个新的博士生职位，研究方向是将视觉-语言-动作模型与3D几何相结合。

该博士职位与 @HelsingAI 紧密合作，与优秀研究者 @TomUnterthiner 一起，将是一个开展研究并产生影响力的独特机会。

更多信息请见：
https://t.co/9FU8ryPTPN

我们特别鼓励来自多元和代表性不足背景的申请者。如果您对是否申请有任何疑问，请给我发消息。
research_focus: Vision-Language-Action Models with 3D Geometry, Embodied AI
application_notes: Collaboration with HelsingAI; encourage diverse backgrounds; contact PI for details

Fully funded PhD position in Applied Space Microbiology at the University of Bremen, Germany, for candidates with a background in Biology, Engineering, Mathematics or Physics. The project focuses on developing sustainable biotechnologies for Mars, including modelling and designing photobioreactors using Martian resources.

Deadline: 18 August 2026.
chinese_translation:
德国不来梅大学应用空间微生物学全额资助博士职位，适合生物学、工程、数学或物理学背景的候选人。项目聚焦为火星开发可持续生物技术，包括使用火星资源建模和设计光生物反应器。

截止日期：2026年8月18日。
research_focus: Applied Space Microbiology, photobioreactors, Martian biotechnologies
application_notes: Fully funded; Deadline 18 August 2026; backgrounds Biology/Engineering/Math/Physics
